title: fix(cli)!: os serve refuses to boot when an installed plugin that may provide the crypto provider is refused at boot
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X1zG3Xn4JonaKvDLLr5gnjL)_

Refs #28284

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — `os serve` (and the `serve` child of `os start` and `os dev`) refuses to boot when a plugin `os plugin install` installed is refused at boot and nothing rules out that it provides the crypto provider (`crypto-provider`), where every such refusal was non-fatal and the boot went on; widened beside it: the optional `declaredServices` on `InstalledPluginRefusal` and `LoadedInstalledPlugin` (`@objectstack/runtime`).
Metadata-protocol: none

<!-- adr-0087: not-required (no-migration-prescription) no key of any schema is added, removed or re-shaped and no stored row is converted: a boot whose installed plugins hold a refusal that may be the crypto provider stops until the operator fixes that plugin or disables it, which is a choice about one installed plugin made by hand, not a mechanical conversion -->

**BREAKING** for a deployment that boots `os serve`, `os start` or `os dev` with an installed plugin (`os plugin install`) that is refused at boot.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：用 `os plugin install` 安装的插件，启动时会再验证一次。现在若某个已安装插件在启动时被拒、又无法排除它是加密提供者(`crypto-provider`)，`os serve`(以及 `os start`、`os dev` 的 serve 子进程)拒绝启动，点名该插件、拒绝代码和让下次启动继续的步骤。规则与栈 `plugins` 里加载失败的项相同。
- **为什么改**：QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)
- **风险与回滚**：改 `@objectstack/cli` 和 `@objectstack/runtime`(均为 patch，声明为 `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`)。
  - 以下情况照旧继续启动：没有安装记录的项目；被禁用的插件；运行层级不是 `node` 的插件(`runtime_undeclared`、`runtime_not_dispatched`)；已导入、是对象、且 `providesServices` 可读并且不含 `crypto-provider` 的被拒插件。
  - 其余被拒的已安装插件会让启动停下，包括整个加载器失败。
  - runtime 的两个已发布类型各新增一个可选字段 `declaredServices`。
  - 回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` 的 `refuseRefusedInstalledCryptoProviderPlugins`，以及它在 `registerInstalledPlugins` 之后的那一次调用。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project integration test/serve-installed-plugins.integration.test.ts`，预期 9/9。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位做 contract review 后落地。

## What changes

- **Before.** A refused installed plugin was printed (`✗ Refused installed plugin id@version (code)`), and the boot went on without it, whatever the refusal.
- **Now.** `os serve` refuses to boot when an installed plugin that may provide the crypto provider is refused at boot.
  - The new `refuseRefusedInstalledCryptoProviderPlugins(refused)` runs right after the installed plugins register, before the host's crypto provider is chosen and before any plugin starts.
  - It follows the rule `refuseUnloadedCryptoProviderPlugins` keeps for a stack `plugins` entry.
  - **Ruled out** (the boot goes on, as before):
    - a refusal whose verified artifact declares a tier this host does not run in process (`runtime_undeclared`, `runtime_not_dispatched`);
    - a plugin that was imported, is an object, and whose `providesServices` (ADR-0116) could be read and does not name `crypto-provider`.
  - **Refused:** every other refusal, including:
    - one raised before the import;
    - `import_failed`;
    - an import that is not an object;
    - an imported plugin whose declaration throws when read;
    - the loader failing outright (`loader_failed`, `records_unreadable`).
  - A disabled plugin is not a refusal.
- **Remedy.** The refusal names each plugin as `id@version` with its refusal code, and the step that lets the next boot go on. For most codes that step is `os plugin disable <id>`. Codes that `os plugin disable` cannot clear name their own step:
  - `install_dir_unexpected`: install it again;
  - `uninstall_failed` and `record_changed`: a later boot finishes the uninstall;
  - `disabled_state_unreadable`: repair the disable-state file;
  - `records_unreadable`: repair the installations file;
  - `loader_failed`: fix the loader.
- **`@objectstack/runtime` installed-plugin loader:** `InstalledPluginRefusal` and `LoadedInstalledPlugin` gain an optional `declaredServices`.
  - It is read once per imported plugin, and set on a refusal raised after the import (`not_a_plugin`, `signature_conflict`) and on a loaded entry.
  - It holds the string entries of `providesServices`, or `[]` when there are none.
  - It is absent when the plugin was not imported, is not an object, or its declaration throws when read.
- **`registerInstalledPlugins` (cli):** a refusal it raises (`plugin_name_taken`, `kernel_refused`) carries the loaded entry's `declaredServices`.

## Why

QA 第三轮发现的安全加固(细节按披露裁决不公开)

## Verification

Readings on head `dedc92d80`: two commits on `main` at `ae816c40b`. The second answers the contract review: the declaration, a non-object import, each code's own step, and one declaration read.

<details><summary>Pins, red-first and restore</summary>

- `serve-host-crypto-provider.test.ts`: a new describe block (6 cases) for `refuseRefusedInstalledCryptoProviderPlugins`, plus a source-order pin.
  - Every pre-import code that `os plugin disable` clears, and `import_failed`, is refused. The refusal names the plugin, the code and `os plugin disable <id>`.
  - A post-import refusal is judged by `declaredServices`. One that declares `crypto-provider` is refused. Other services and none are ruled out. An unreadable declaration is refused.
  - CONTROL: `runtime_not_dispatched` and `runtime_undeclared` are ruled out, and no refusal at all is not refused.
  - `loader_failed` is refused with no disable remedy.
  - `install_dir_unexpected`, `uninstall_failed`, `record_changed` and `disabled_state_unreadable` each name their own step and no disable. In a mixed refusal, only the clearable code gets the disable.
  - Several refusals are all named, and the ruled-out ones are not.
  - The source-order pin: the check sits after `registerInstalledPlugins` and before the host provider is built.
- `test/serve-installed-plugins.integration.test.ts` (#27123) now boots three times with the real `os serve --no-server` (`OS_MIGRATE_AND_EXIT=1`).
  - First, a refused boot: exit non-zero and no `Migration complete`. The tampered tree (`tree_changed`) and the pre-retirement artifact (`manifest_invalid`) are named with `os plugin disable` for each. The sandbox tier is printed as refused but is not a reason the boot stopped. No installed plugin's `init` ran.
  - Then `os plugin disable` of those two, and the file's original two boots. Those pins are unchanged, except that the tampered and retired installs now read as disabled in the first of them.
  - The test-budget header moves 40 → 60 for the third boot. It reads 22.41 s locally.
- `installed-plugin-loader.test.ts` (runtime, 7 new cases):
  - Post-import refusals carry `declaredServices`, with non-string entries dropped and `[]` for none.
  - A non-object import (a number, a class) carries none.
  - A throwing read leaves it absent.
  - A pre-import refusal carries none.
  - A loaded entry carries its declaration.
- `installed-plugins-boot.test.ts` (1 new case): `kernel_refused` and `plugin_name_taken` copy the loaded entry's `declaredServices`, and carry none when the loader read none.
- Red-first, first commit: with `serve.ts` set back to its `main` blob, the integration file plus `serve-host-crypto-provider.test.ts` read 9 failed | 35 passed (44).
  - The refused-boot pin failed.
  - Two later pins failed, because the untouched plugin's `init` had already run in that boot.
  - The 6 then-new crypto cases failed.
- Red-first, second commit: against the first commit's blobs, the loader file read 2 failed | 63 passed (65), on the two non-object rows. The crypto file read 1 failed | 35 passed (36), on the own-step case.
- Restored, on this head:
  - the integration file plus the crypto file: 45 passed (45);
  - the boot helper: 8/8;
  - the loader: 65/65.

</details>

<details><summary>Package suites and typecheck</summary>

- `tsc --noEmit` in `packages/cli` and `packages/runtime`: exit 0.
- On the first commit under the verify lock, before the rebase onto `ae816c40b`:
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: Test Files 555 passed (555), Tests 8962 passed | 19 skipped, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
  - `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli test`: Test Files 608 passed | 1 skipped (609), Tests 7551 passed | 9 skipped, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
  - The rebase's only overlap with this diff is a 3-line comment change elsewhere in `serve.ts`. The second commit changes the three files whose pins are read above.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the changed source and test files: exit 0.
- `check-adr-0087-registration`: the changeset reads `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing] not-required (no-migration-prescription)`. `check-changeset-no-major`: OK.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` derives 72 families on this head.
- Every family ran and exited 0. `check:type-check-debt` ran under the verify lock.
- `--ran` reconciliation: 72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

</details>

Not measured:
- A real crypto-provider plugin installed and refused end to end. The integration pins refuse with a plain node plugin; the provider-declaration branch is pinned at the function and at the loader.
